name: Glen More II: Chronicles

categories.label: Points gained so far (scoring rounds 1-3 and play)
categories.labelVi: Điểm đã có (3 vòng chấm điểm và trong game)
categories.hint: Victory points already earned before the final scoring round.

categories.label: Scotsmen on Home Castle: lead over lowest
categories.labelVi: Quân Scotsmen ở Home Castle: hơn người ít nhất
categories.hint: Difference to the player with the fewest. 1/2/3/4/5+ = 1/2/3/5/8 VP. Castle Moil doubles your Scotsmen.

categories.label: Landmark cards: lead over lowest
categories.labelVi: Thẻ Landmark: hơn người ít nhất
categories.hint: Difference to the player with the fewest. 1/2/3/4/5+ = 1/2/3/5/8 VP.

categories.label: Whisky casks: lead over lowest
categories.labelVi: Thùng Whisky: hơn người ít nhất
categories.hint: Difference to the player with the fewest. 1/2/3/4/5+ = 1/2/3/5/8 VP.

categories.label: Person tiles: lead over lowest
categories.labelVi: Thẻ Person: hơn người ít nhất
categories.hint: Difference to the player with the fewest. 1/2/3/4/5+ = 1/2/3/5/8 VP.

categories.label: Territory size: tiles more than the smallest territory
categories.labelVi: Lãnh thổ: số ô nhiều hơn người ít nhất
categories.hint: Each tile above the player with the fewest tiles costs 3 VP (persons do not count).

categories.label: Coins
categories.hint: 1 VP per coin (first 8 coins give 2 VP each with Armadale Castle; add the extra in landmark bonuses).

categories.label: End-game landmark card bonuses
categories.hint: Additional VP from landmark cards that score at game end.

notes: family: area-majority-diff. Scoring rounds 1-3 happen mid-game (when stacks A, B, C run out) and are recorded in the points-so-far field; the final round repeats the four-area comparison. Each comparison is the difference to the player with the least, not rank based. Chronicles modules (Haggis, Great Glen scoring cards, etc.) and solo/coop are not modelled.

sources.title: Glen More II: Chronicles Rulebook V2.0 (FunTails)
